semiconductor_relevance: High — GrandiT Co., Ltd is directly involved in the manufacturing of semiconductor wafers and substrates, which are critical components in the semiconductor value chain.
summary: GrandiT Co., Ltd is a manufacturer specializing in semiconductor wafers and substrates, including both silicon and compound materials. The company also produces semiconductor displays, fiber optic preforms, and is involved in photovoltaic manufacturing, emphasizing innovation and reliability to support industry growth.
